note: Scripture fragment spliced byte-for-byte from Kulish (1905), parsed whole from the ebible mirror (ukr_pan); checked mechanically as a verbatim substring of its Kulish verse (first letter lowercased mid-sentence).
Unquoted echoes (John 9:25 in “Amazing Grace”, Galatians 1:23 in the epitaph) are Newton’s own words, rendered as prose and not listed.

“Amazing Grace” is given its established Ukrainian title «Дивна благодать»; Newton’s other works (Olney Hymns, Cardiphonia, Thoughts upon the African Slave Trade) are plain translations for native review. “wretch” is «нікчема» throughout.
